title_tag: 8 Best Luxury Hotels in Budapest (2026): 5-Star Compared
meta_description: Budapest's 5-star hotels compared: price per night, guest scores, pools, spas, breakfast and metro walks. From €187 at Kempinski to €500 at Four Seasons.
h1_main: 8 Best Luxury and 5-Star Hotels in Budapest
author_role: 8 five-star hotels compared on price per night, guest scores, value for money, pools and location
lead: The right 5-star hotel in Budapest is the one that fits your stay: the most included in the room rate (that is Aria, the #1 pick, €263), a full 5-star with a pool for under €200, a room facing the Chain Bridge, or an address on Andrássy Avenue or Váci utca. Travelling on a smaller budget? The boutique hotels start under €100. This page gets you to the right room in under a minute.

To make the choice easy, I compared all 8 on what decides a luxury booking: the price for the same night, the guest score and the value-for-money score behind it, pool and spa, breakfast rating, and how far you walk to the metro, checked on each hotel's own listing. Filter by pool, pets, step-free access or price below, or scroll straight to the ranking.
breakdown_title: Detailed Breakdown: 8 Best Luxury Hotels in Budapest

guide.html:
All prices are for the same night (Wednesday 10 March 2027, 2 adults, 1 room), so the gaps are real. Scores are out of 10.

What the numbers say: the price spread is wider than the quality spread. Kempinski costs €187 and Four Seasons €500 for the same night, yet their guest scores are 0.1 apart; what you pay for at Four Seasons is the Chain Bridge address, and guests score its value for money 8.3, the lowest here. Aria has the highest guest score (9.6) and value score (9.2) because breakfast, the spa and an afternoon wine and cheese are included.

• Best all-round stay: #1 Aria, with breakfast, spa and the wine hour included.
  • 5-star with a pool for the least money: #2 Kempinski (€187).
  • The postcard view: #3 Four Seasons, facing the Chain Bridge.
  • Shopping and cafés on the doorstep: #5 Matild Palace on Váci utca.
  • Opera and Andrássy Avenue: #7 W Budapest.
  • Travelling with a dog: Kempinski, Párisi Udvar or W.

Want the bath culture too? See the spa and thermal hotels and the thermal baths.

guide.h2: Before You Book: Breakfast, Parking and Timing
guide.html:
Breakfast: only Aria lists breakfast as part of every stay. At the others it depends on the rate, so compare the room-only and breakfast rates before you pay.

Parking: all eight list valet or garage parking; it is charged on top of the room.

Location: seven of the eight sit in District V or on Andrássy Avenue, between a 50 ft and 1,000 ft walk from a metro station. Anantara New York Palace is on the Grand Boulevard in District VII, 900 ft from Blaha Lujza tér.

Getting in from the airport: see Budapest airport to the city centre; several of these hotels list an airport shuttle at extra cost.

Celebrating? Pair the stay with a dinner cruise or a private boat.

faqs.q: What is the best luxury hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Aria Hotel Budapest has the highest guest score of the 5-star hotels here (9.6) and includes breakfast, its spa and an afternoon wine and cheese. For the classic grand-hotel view, Four Seasons Gresham Palace faces the Chain Bridge.

faqs.q: How much is a 5-star hotel in Budapest per night?
faqs.a: On a March weeknight for 2 adults, from €187 (Kempinski Hotel Corvinus) to €500 (Four Seasons Gresham Palace). Most of the others cost €246 to €334.

faqs.q: Which 5-star hotels in Budapest have a pool?
faqs.a: Aria, Kempinski Corvinus, Four Seasons (infinity-edge), Anantara New York Palace (heated), W Budapest and Al Habtoor Palace list an indoor pool. Párisi Udvar and Matild Palace have a spa or wellness centre without a listed pool.

faqs.q: Which luxury hotel is closest to the Chain Bridge?
faqs.a: Four Seasons Gresham Palace, about 1,650 ft from the bridge on Széchenyi István tér.

faqs.q: Are pets allowed in Budapest's 5-star hotels?
faqs.a: Kempinski Corvinus, Párisi Udvar and W Budapest list pets as welcome; fees may apply.

faqs.q: Is breakfast included at 5-star hotels in Budapest?
faqs.a: Only Aria includes it in every stay. Elsewhere it depends on the rate you choose.

methodology: We compared Budapest's best-reviewed 5-star hotels on what decides a luxury booking: the price for the same night (10 March 2027, 2 adults), the guest score and its value-for-money and location sub-scores, pool and spa, breakfast rating, parking, pets, accessibility and the walk to the nearest metro, all from each hotel's live listing.

review: Aria wins because so much is in the price. For €263 on our test night you get a buffet breakfast with dishes made to order, an afternoon wine and cheese with live music and the Harmony Spa with its pool, saunas and steam bath. Guests score it 9.6, the highest of the eight, and 9.2 for value for money.

It sits on Hercegprímás utca, about 350 ft from Deák Ferenc tér, so the Basilica, Andrássy Avenue and the Chain Bridge are all walkable. Rooms are themed around four music styles and the rooftop bar looks over downtown.
Pick it unless you want the river-facing grandeur of Four Seasons or a cheaper 5-star with a bigger pool, in which case Kempinski is €76 less.

Book it for the view and the building, ideally a river-facing room, rather than for the extras per euro.
